'''Greve''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Guard]] who served during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Greve was among the contingent of Imperial forces sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in order to combat the [[Dread Host]], the enthralled forces of the rogue [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Greve appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Mission Support Vendor for the Imperial faction in the Section X Daily Area, which was added in Game Update 1.5: HK-51 Activated on [[November 15]], [[2012]].<ref name="TOR" /> According to the game's files, he is [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="NPC">According to [http://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/lieutenant-greve the character's NPC], Greve is Human underneath his helmet.</ref>
